Title: Azure Machine Learning supports Azure Active Directory

Body.Content: We have released Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) support in Azure Machine Learning. You can sign in with any Azure AD work or school account, in addition to the already supported Microsoft accounts (LiveID). Additionally, you can invite other Azure AD users to your workspace. For more information, please see Azure Machine Learning supports Azure Active Directory.
Body.Markdown:
We have released Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) support in Azure Machine Learning. You can sign in with any Azure AD work or school account, in addition to the already supported Microsoft accounts (LiveID). Additionally, you can invite other Azure AD users to your workspace.

For more information, please see Azure Machine Learning supports Azure Active Directory .
